text: Axitinib is a potent, selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor that binds to the ATP-binding pocket of KDR (VEGFR-2), effectively blocking its autophosphorylation and downstream signaling pathways. In Renal Cell Carcinoma, this inhibition suppresses tumor angiogenesis and cell proliferation by preventing the KDR-mediated activation of the VEGF signaling cascade. This interaction is well-documented and serves as the primary mechanism for Axitinib's clinical efficacy in treating advanced renal cell carcinoma.
